evidence: app/src/pages/abilities/[name].astro:1-46 — the whole feature is one route file, deletable outright
app/src/pages/pokemon/[name].astro:132-141 — only cross-file link source: the Abilities section in the Pokémon page
app/src/layouts/Base.astro:32-37 — nav has no Abilities link, so no layout edit needed
app/src/styles/global.css:145 — .plain-list style would become dead after Abilities removal
removability.rationale: Route-per-feature with a single in-page link source; removing Abilities is a directory delete plus one section edit and one orphaned CSS rule. Only deduction is that page-scoped CSS lives in a single global.css, so dead styles linger unless hunted.

evidence: app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:95-112 — cardsForPokemon centralizes pokemon-ref→species mapping (the Deoxys case), used by moves, abilities and types pages
app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:32 — single spriteUrl used by CardList for every card list, so a sprite fix lands once
app/src/lib/api.ts:5-65 — API base URL, /api/v2 prefix and all caching rules in one file
app/src/layouts/Base.astro:40-41 — TEAM_COOKIE/MAX_TEAM_SIZE and cookie read/write duplicated from lib/team.ts:4-5; a rename or size change needs two edits
app/src/components/MovesSection.astro:145-172 and app/src/pages/index.astro:88-110 — the fetch→DOMParser→replaceWith partial-refresh pattern implemented twice
changeability.rationale: The scored bug-fix and data-source changes each land in one obvious module. But team constants and the partial-refresh client pattern are duplicated, so some fixes need to be made twice.

evidence: app/src/layouts/Base.astro:59-97 — the layout owns team mutation behavior (data-team-add/remove handling, cookie write, location.reload) and ships it on every page
app/src/components/CardList.astro:5,27-31 — generic card component carries a team-specific removable prop and data-team-remove attribute
app/src/lib/team.ts:35-36 — getTeamFromCookies takes a narrow structural cookie interface, a clean seam
app/src/pages/index.astro:8-16 — pages depend only on lib helpers, not on each other
app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:1 — lib modules compose through narrow exports; no component reaches into another's internals
coupling.rationale: Pages and lib helpers are cleanly separated, but the team feature is entangled with the base layout (feature logic in a shared layout, constants duplicated server/client) and leaks a team-specific prop into the shared CardList component.

evidence: app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:88-112 — the Card type plus cardsForPokemon with an optional note callback absorbs real variation (hidden-ability note, alternate-form filtering, dedup) without flag creep
app/src/components/CardList.astro:1-34 — one component renders all five card lists (home, moves, abilities, types, team)
app/src/components/MovesSection.astro:82-88 — table columns are data-driven per method rather than boolean flags
app/src/components/Section.astro:1-15 — small section abstraction reused on every detail page
app/src/pages/moves/[name].astro:29 and app/src/components/MovesSection.astro:87 — show/DASH formatting helper redefined per file instead of shared next to DASH in pokedex.ts:31
abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions track the app's genuine variation well (cards, sections, type badges, method-driven move tables) and stretch to an Items section with mostly reuse. Only the duplicated client-side refresh pattern and per-file formatting helpers needed extraction.

findings.issue: Team cookie constants (TEAM_COOKIE, MAX_TEAM_SIZE) and read/write/normalise logic are duplicated from app/src/lib/team.ts:4-36; changing the cookie name, format or team size silently risks server/client divergence.
findings.suggestion: Astro bundles inline <script> tags, so import { TEAM_COOKIE, MAX_TEAM_SIZE, parseTeamCookie } from '../lib/team' in the layout script (team.ts has no server-only imports), keeping one source of truth.

findings.issue: The fetch-page → DOMParser → replaceWith partial-refresh + popstate pattern is implemented independently in app/src/pages/index.astro:88-110; abort handling, error fallback and history semantics must be maintained in both.
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared client helper (e.g. src/scripts/partial-refresh.ts) with a fetch(url, elementId) function both scripts use.

findings.issue: Team feature behavior lives in the base layout (event delegation for data-team-add/remove, cookie write, location.reload), so changing team interactions or removing the feature means editing a file every page shares.
findings.suggestion: Move the team script into a dedicated component imported by the pages that render team buttons (or keep it in Base but import shared constants), and remove it together with the feature.

findings.issue: The generic CardList has a team-specific removable prop and data-team-remove button, coupling a shared display component to one feature.
findings.suggestion: Accept a named slot for per-card extras and let the team page supply its own remove button.

findings.issue: The show()/DASH missing-value formatting helper is redefined here and again in app/src/components/MovesSection.astro:87 instead of living next to DASH in app/src/lib/pokedex.ts:31.
findings.suggestion: Export a single formatValue/show helper from lib/pokedex.ts and import it in both.

findings.issue: getTypeLabels is built on getTypes(), which fetches and holds all 18 full type records; callers that only need labels (e.g. moves/[name].astro:29-32) drag in damage-relation data.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable given the runtime cache, but a lighter labels-only helper would decouple label consumers from the full TypeInfo shape.

summary: This is a genuinely editable codebase: data access, caching and the pokemon→species mapping are each centralized in one lib module, and every card list flows through a single CardList component, so the scored bug fix and data-source changes land in exactly one place. Abstractions (Card, Section, TypeBadge, data-driven move tables) are shaped around the app's real variation and would absorb an Items section with mostly reuse. The main deductions are duplicated logic — team cookie handling in both lib/team.ts and the Base layout script, and the partial-refresh client pattern appearing in two pages — and the team feature's leakage into the shared layout and CardList component.
